extraction: Use each declared individual sheet, all finite positive-time stress records, stable chronological sort and first duplicate. No smoothing, response-peak selection, subtraction or author-colored-row exclusion. Use nearest recorded time; record actual times, never replace by nominal. Require target after all training observations. Normalize stress by its value at the nearest recorded anchor. Save modulus only for provenance, never infer an independent loading record from stress/modulus.
information_class: Conditional positive effective hold-state relaxation spectrum from anchor onward, no future loading changes. This restricted continuation task does not require reconstructing the preceding ramp; it does assume that the effective state admits a finite positive spectrum. In the shared numerical engine beta=gamma=1 and dead_time=0 encode normalized exponentials, not a measured polynomial ramp.
noise_rule: The 1%, 3%, 5% bands are assumed normalized-stress sensitivity scenarios fixed before prediction, not calibrated sensor errors, inferred fit residuals, empirical quantiles or coverage probabilities. Normalization uncertainty is not independently qualified.
fit_comparator: Nonnegative least squares on the same observation values and 128 logarithmic rates 1e-6..128 plus equilibrium. Its finite rate dictionary is a numerical point fit, not a physical rate-support prior used by P4. No held-out tuning. Report convergence and point errors without superiority claims.
go_rule: Retain all 12 traces and all three assumed band widths; do not expand after seeing favorable outcomes. Report strict-feasibility failures as unresolved, no calibrated guarantee; show all held-out errors and interval inclusion including failures. No unsupported physical or industrial validation.
exposure: Header/schema and first few rows inspected before freeze; this is an exploratory secondary-data pilot. No prediction or terminal-error outcome from this new source was inspected before protocol creation. Twelve sheets are not asserted to be twelve independent donors.
qualification_gaps: No independent time-resolved loading column in relaxation sheets
No independent deterministic response-error and denominator-error budgets in the acquired archive
Positive effective hold-state spectrum remains a modeling assumption; source linear oscillatory limit alone does not establish it
Source author summary sheets average and select records; pilot instead retains every individual raw-sheet trace
scope: Empirical restricted hold continuation and failure analysis only, not validated cross-loading response prediction or a test of the loading endpoint boundary theorem
